text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['proto'] != 'tcp') | (df['swin'] >= 0)","(df['proto'] != 'tcp') | (df['dwin'] >= 0)","(df['proto'] != 'tcp') | (df['stcpb'] >= 0)","(df['proto'] != 'tcp') | (df['dtcpb'] >= 0)"],"features":["proto","swin","dwin","stcpb","dtcpb"],"rationale":"TCP window advertisement and base sequence number are TCP-specific fields; for non-TCP protocols they must be zero or absent."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['proto'] != 'tcp') | (df['tcprtt'] >= 0)","(df['proto'] != 'tcp') | (df['synack'] >= 0)","(df['proto'] != 'tcp') | (df['ackdat'] >= 0)"],"features":["proto","tcprtt","synack","ackdat"],"rationale":"TCP connection setup timing features (synack, ackdat, tcprtt) are only meaningful for TCP flows; for non-TCP they must be zero or absent."},{"id":"R3","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] != 'http') | (df['trans_depth'] >= 0)","(df['service'] != 'http') | (df['response_body_len'] >= 0)"],"features":["service","trans_depth","response_body_len"],"rationale":"HTTP transaction depth and response body length are HTTP-specific; for non-HTTP services they must be zero or absent."},{"id":"R4","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] != 'ftp') | (df['is_ftp_login'] == 0)","(df['service'] != 'ftp') | (df['ct_ftp_cmd'] == 0)"],"features":["service","is_ftp_login","ct_ftp_cmd"],"rationale":"FTP login indicator and FTP command count are FTP-specific; for non-FTP services they must be zero."},{"id":"R5","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] != 'http') | (df['ct_flw_http_mthd'] == 0)"],"features":["service","ct_flw_http_mthd"],"rationale":"HTTP method flow count is HTTP-specific; for non-HTTP services it must be zero."},{"id":"R6","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['proto'] != 'tcp') | (df['state'].isin(['ACC','CLO','CON','ECO','ECR','FIN','INT','MAS','PAR','REQ','RST','TST','TXD','URH','URN','-']))"],"features":["proto","state"],"rationale":"The documented state values are TCP connection states; for non-TCP protocols the state should be '-' (not used) or one of the documented values."},{"id":"R7","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['proto'] != 'tcp') | (df['state'] != '-')"],"features":["proto","state"],"rationale":"TCP flows that completed a handshake should have a meaningful state rather than '-' (not used)."}]}
